Home›Six-week groups›The Unstiffening
Six-week group for stiff backs, every gender

Your back called.It would like a word.

The Unstiffening is for anyone with a stiff back, tight hips or a sore neck from sitting at a desk or driving all day. Lunchtime strength basics downstairs and a deep stretch in the warm room upstairs, with time to shower before you go back to work.

Book your placeCompare all groups

Starts Tuesday 10 November. Or text Helen on 07718 339510

Is this for you?

  • You sit at a desk or drive for most of the day
  • Your back, hips or shoulders feel stiff, especially in the morning
  • You'd like a short lunchtime session rather than an evening class
  • You want something practical, with no chanting and no headstands

A six-week group

The Unstiffening is one of our six-week groups. It meets twice a week, once downstairs in the gym and once upstairs in the studio, with up to 10 people so Helen gets to know everyone. It runs in six-week cycles all year: the next starts Tuesday 10 November, and the one after that in the week of 11 January 2027. When your six weeks are up, you can carry on into the next cycle or move into any class on our regular timetable.

Tuesdays and Thursdays, 12:15pm£50 for six weeks
Book your place

Can't make this cycle? Leave your details for the next one.

What happens in a session

Downstairs, in the gym

Strength

  • Mobility. Hips, upper back, neck and shoulders
  • Strength basics. Squat, hinge, push, pull and carry
  • Stretch. Hamstrings and hips
  • Breathe and go. Back to work feeling looser
45 minutesUnheated
Upstairs, in the studio

Warm stretch

  • Settle. Shoes off, phone away
  • Spine and hips. Mobility for the desk and the car
  • Deep stretch. No chanting and no headstands
  • Breathe and go. Time left to shower
45 minutesWarm, about 28°C

Questions

Will it help my back pain?

Lots of people find that moving more and getting stronger eases everyday stiffness. If you have pain that's new, severe or getting worse, see your GP or a physio first.

Is it hot?

The gym session is unheated. The stretch upstairs is warm, about 28°C, which helps your muscles relax. It isn't hot yoga.

Who comes along?

Mostly people who sit at a desk or drive all day, men and women alike.

When are the sessions?

Tuesdays and Thursdays, 12:15pm, starting Tuesday 10 November. The six weeks finish on Thursday 17 December.

Is it a one-off?

No. The groups run in six-week cycles all year. The next cycle starts Tuesday 10 November, and the one after that in the week of 11 January 2027. You can join at the start of any cycle, and carry on from one to the next.

How do I join?

Book and pay online through our booking system, Gymcatch. You can use the app or book straight from your browser. If you'd like to ask a question first, text Helen on 07718 339510 and she'll get back to you.
